title: GMAT Focus Data Insights Practice Test 20
instructions: Original exam-style practice test with answers and explanations.

questions.prompt: A graph showing gym membership usage in the fitness sector presents the following data: Peak hours 6-8am: 42%, 12-2pm: 18%, 5-8pm: 56%, 8-10pm: 23%, Other: 12%. According to the graph, which segment/period shows the highest value?
options: D. The value closest to the overall average
E. Cannot be determined from the data
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret fitness data on gym membership usage.

questions.prompt: Based on the chart of incident response times data (Detection: 4.2h, Containment: 2.8h, Eradication: 6.1h, Recovery: 12.4h, Documentation: 3.9h), which TWO values would combine to equal approximately the average?
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret cybersecurity data on incident response times.

questions.prompt: A scatter plot comparing occupancy rates by building type across property management categories shows: Office A-grade: 94%, Office B-grade: 78%, Retail flagship: 97%, Retail secondary: 81%, Industrial: 89%. If the trend continued, which projection is most consistent?
options: A. The value closest to the overall average
B. Cannot be determined from the data
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret property management data on occupancy rates by building type.

dataContext.data: Office A-grade: 94%, Office B-grade: 78%, Retail flagship: 97%, Retail secondary: 81%, Industrial: 89%

visual.title: Occupancy Rates By Building Type — Property Management

questions.prompt: A graph showing quarterly revenue in the retail sales sector presents the following data: Q1: $2.4M, Q2: $3.1M, Q3: $2.8M, Q4: $3.6M. According to the graph, which segment/period shows the highest value?
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret retail sales data on quarterly revenue.

questions.prompt: Analysis of patient wait times in hospital operations: Emergency: 45min, Outpatient: 28min, Radiology: 62min, Laboratory: 19min. Select the value closest to the median AND the value that represents the greatest deviation from the mean.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret hospital operations data on patient wait times.

questions.prompt: Given university admissions application success rates data: Engineering: 12%, Business: 18%, Arts: 25%, Sciences: 15%, Law: 9%. In the left column select the highest-performing category; in the right column select the category that improved most year-over-year.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret university admissions data on application success rates.

questions.prompt: A logistics manager reviews delivery performance: On-time: 78%, Early: 8%, Late <1 day: 10%, Late >1 day: 4%. Select: (1) the category requiring immediate attention and (2) the category that exceeds the target of the average by the greatest margin.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret logistics data on delivery performance.

dataContext.data: On-time: 78%, Early: 8%, Late <1 day: 10%, Late >1 day: 4%

questions.prompt: Analysis of engagement metrics in social media: Likes per post: 340, Shares: 89, Comments: 47, Click-through: 6.2%. Select the value closest to the median AND the value that represents the greatest deviation from the mean.

questions.prompt: Three data sources on energy consumption monthly utility costs are provided: (Memo) Overall performance improved this quarter. (Table) Jan: $4,200, Apr: $2,900, Jul: $5,800, Oct: $3,100. (Email) Stakeholders express concern about outliers. Which source most directly supports the memo's claim?
options: C. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret energy consumption data on monthly utility costs.

questions.prompt: Source 1 (Report): employee performance training completion rates shows: Sales: 91%, Operations: 73%, HR: 88%, Finance: 95%, IT: 82%. Source 2 (Email): The weakest performer needs a 20% improvement to meet targets. Source 3 (Table): Targets are set at the top-quartile value. Which category needs improvement?
options: D. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret employee performance data on training completion rates.

questions.prompt: Reviewing real estate records: Source A shows property price indices: City centre: 148, Suburbs: 112, Rural: 89, Coastal: 167. Source B notes the average. Source C flags values more than 25% above or below average. Which values would Source C flag?
options: E. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret real estate data on property price indices.

questions.prompt: Three data sources on pharmaceutical clinical trial outcomes are provided: (Memo) Overall performance improved this quarter. (Table) Complete response: 34%, Partial response: 28%, Stable disease: 21%, Progression: 17%. (Email) Stakeholders express concern about outliers. Which source most directly supports the memo's claim?
options: A. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret pharmaceutical data on clinical trial outcomes.

dataContext.data: Complete response: 34%, Partial response: 28%, Stable disease: 21%, Progression: 17%

questions.prompt: What is the relative ranking of categories in airline operations on-time performance by route? (1) Domestic short: 88%. (2) The remaining values follow a consistent trend.
options: A. Each statement alone is sufficient
B. Neither statement alone nor together is sufficient
C. Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not sufficient
D. Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not sufficient
E. Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is sufficient
questions.explanation: This data_sufficiency question tests ability to interpret airline operations data on on-time performance by route.

dataContext.data: Domestic short: 88%, Domestic long: 79%, International: 71%, Regional: 84%
